description: Golden questions for the agent. expected_tools = at least one must be called; grounding check = every number in the answer must appear in some tool output.

cases.question: How many days in the observed window had gusts above the critical 21 m/s threshold at each station?
What is the latest sawlog price in Götaland and how has it moved quarter over quarter?
If a windstorm cuts harvest supply by 40% for 6 weeks, which node stocks out first and what is the network fill rate?
How concentrated is our harvest supply base?
What will the sawlog price be in 2028?
